name: Dream

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you know on the same plane

summary: Speak to a creature on your plane through its dreams, or plague it with a nightmare.
text: You or a willing messenger enter the target's dreams while it sleeps. A nightmare lets it make a Wis save; on a failure it gains no benefit from that rest and takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes.
